tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL during internship at Sunflower Trip, taken live for real customer bookings.
Delivered a full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system with an Angular frontend and a C# and MS SQL Server backend, deployed on Azure for a freelance restaurant client.
Built Zenvest, a full-stack stock trading platform across three services with JWT-based authentication, Joi-based request validation, and an Express API proxy.
Developed StaySphere, an Airbnb-style property rental platform featuring listing CRUD, Cloudinary-backed image uploads, Passport.js authentication, and ownership-based authorization.
kit.cover_letter: I am writing to express my interest in the Full Stack Engineer / Tech Intern position at IONIC. As an MCA student at PES University with practical full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL that went live for real customer bookings, implementing role-based access control and an admin dashboard. Additionally, I delivered a Point of Sale system for a freelance restaurant client using an Angular frontend, C# and MS SQL Server backend, and deployed it on Azure. My project work includes developing Zenvest, a full-stack stock trading platform clone with JWT authentication and Joi-based request validation, and StaySphere, an Airbnb-style rental platform using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. I am comfortable writing code, troubleshooting and debugging software, and collaborating across functional workflows as required for this on-site role in Bangalore. Thank you for considering my application, and I look forward to discussing how my technical background aligns with your team's needs.
